title: Script instruction open result
summary: Tests an instruction word's six-bit opcode and high nine-bit field. Returns one for opcodes 28, 29, 30 or 34 only when bits 23 through 31 are zero; otherwise returns zero. The original receives the word in ECX and has no memory side effects.
test_description: Compare against the original for all 64 opcodes with zero, all middle bits, all high bits, all non-opcode bits, and every individual non-opcode bit, plus 4096 deterministic words. Install test-owned FS storage before each original call and check its head afterward. The function receives only a value and has no memory accesses.
known_limits: The semantic names of the four opcodes and other instruction fields are not established.
The portable interface uses a normal C++ value argument; the original uses ECX as a register argument.
Behavioral samples do not establish matching machine code.
